title: Arrow Bow SFX
description: Changes the Bow SFX to have snappier sounds. Bow sounds are originally from Arrow (sound cut by TheBlast)
body:
This resource pack will change the sound to your bow. Having snappier firing sounds and draw of your bowstring.

Known Issues: Sound will replace anything that uses the default bow, meaning throwing objects like snowballs will play the modified sound.

Credits:
Sounds from CW Arrow
Sound files from TheBlast (https://youtu.be/0hurwvs_EyQ)
